name: Block Generator
description: Generates complete block JSON definitions from a design specification. Produces valid .block.json files with config.nodes, system prompts, and correct wiring. Uses existing blocks as few-shot examples.

inputs.description: Architecture design from design-architecture (blocks, flow, models, creation order)
Specification for the specific block to generate (from design.blocks[i])

outputs.description: Complete block JSON definition ready to be written to disk
System prompt markdown content for agent/inference blocks
